title: Thunder Envoy
summary: Lei Daozi survives and flees Planet Ran Yun, but his own lightning beast turns on him, and Wang Lin catches him with his origin power spent. Lei Daozi agrees to a 'slave seal', but Wang Lin draws out his soul and forges his Illusory Yin body into a second Immortal Guard, offering freedom after thirty years. The soul is destroyed in the forging, so the new guard reaches peak silver tier but cannot use divine arts. From Lei Daozi's belongings Wang Lin gains the Thunder Origin Art, which turns lightning into origin power and could halve his time to the Second Step, a real Thunder Celestial Temple token and a fortune in immortal jade that lifts his avatar to late Ascendant. Using the envoy title, he makes the Huan clan hand over its Celestial Ascension Fruits, turns down Qian Kuizi's oath of loyalty, and gathers more fruit across the Northern Domain over half a year. Near Planet Yun Xia, Tan Lang, trapped somewhere for seventy years, fails his eighth escape attempt and curses Wang Lin for bringing him to Allheaven.

The trapped man at the end is not named; his voice, his cauldron and EP144 show it is Tan Lang, stuck inside the Moonwatcher.
